parameters.content:
## Pharmacy Intake Triage Agent
Faxed referrals, e-Rx, PA forms, insurance cards and patient letters in → classified, extracted, validated and routed to the right ops queue with a status update drafted.

**Queues:** benefits_verification · prior_authorization · missing_info_outreach · customer_care · manual_review

**Guardrails:** LLM only extracts. Code checks NPI check digit (CMS), DOB, ICD-10 format, required fields per doc type and AI confidence ≥ 0.75. Status messages come from fixed templates (minimum necessary PHI).

**KPIs logged per document (no PHI):** processing time, auto-routed vs human, issues, confidence, token estimate, minutes saved.

⚠️ Demo uses synthetic patients only. Production: BAA-covered LLM endpoint, self-hosted OCR (Docling), audit logs.
